The phone thinks the leaf may have this problem. Compare with the leaf in front of you before you spray anything.
Try again with one leaf close up, in daylight, against a plain background. If the leaf is not from a crop listed on the website, this checker cannot judge it.
The checker knows only one condition for this crop, so it cannot tell a healthy leaf from a sick one. Ask an agriculture officer or use the Ask tab.
This is a hint from the phone alone. Photos taken in a field are often misjudged. Show the leaf to an agriculture officer before you spend money on treatment.
Why only a hint? The checker was trained on clean lab photos. The website adds more checks (the right crop, a visible leaf), and this app does not.
